propositions: Compromised GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN was logged in plaintext by uvicorn access logs when sourced from query parameter ?token= because TokenRedactingFilter and X-Rebar-Token header sourcing were not yet deployed

Fix 66af (Gerrit 1384) moves token sourcing from URL query string to X-Rebar-Token header and adds redaction filter, but is merged to main and not yet deployed to production container i-00880b2c7f13527c5 (image built 2026-08-04T11:07Z, before 1384 merged)
Token must not be rotated until 66af is deployed to production; rotating before deployment would immediately re-leak the new token on next webhook call

GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN is a shared secret serving three functions simultaneously: Gerrit HTTP basic-auth password (outbound), inbound webhook secret (?token= or header), and container environment variable; bare SSM updates desynchronize these and break the LLM-Review gate

Correct rotation requires coordinated sequence: deploy 66af to prod, rotate token via service-user.sh (Gerrit password + SSM + webhooks.config), restart container, and verify end-to-end webhook and outbound vote succeed with new credential

Operator attested that rotation and credential purge are complete and force-closed the ticket; three infrastructure ACs (deploy confirmation, rotation sub-parts, post-rotation verification) were marked un-ticked as evidence exists only outside the repository
